BiblicalUsage: Evi is a Midianitish chief. In Numbers 31:8, the text says "Evi." The life behind the name is told on the Evi People profile.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Evi matters because God knows His people by name, and Evi is one of them. That is why I want the name, and the person behind it, kept straight.
